 Jason Derulo to headline Sunday night at Formula 1 Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix 2026
 Published:
 17 Nov 2026 - 05:29 pm
 | Last Updated:
 17 Nov 2026 - 05:30 pm 
 Follow
 us news
 Copy
 A+ 
 A- 
 The Peninsula
 Doha, Qatar: As excitement builds ahead of the Formula 1 Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix 2026, Lusail International Circuit (LIC) is thrilled to announce that global powerhouse Jason Derulo will take to the Lusail Live stage on Sunday, November 29, 2026. His headline show promises an unforgettable night for fans attending the race, combining high energy live entertainment off the track with world class racing.
 Derulo has built one of pop music’s most enduring careers, with Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hits including “Whatcha Say” and “Savage Love,” more than 250 million singles sold, and over 300 million followers across platforms. He closes out a standout 2026 in Doha, following the global success of “Mi Chico (Jason Derulo x Melody x DJ Goja),” which spent six weeks at No. 1 on Billboard’s U.S. Afrobeats chart, surpassed 368 million streams, and sparked a viral dance trend that has generated more than 2 billion views. The track will feature on his upcoming album, The Last Dance (Part 2), scheduled for release in early 2027. Fans can look forward to a high-energy performance featuring the global hits that have kept him at the forefront of pop music for nearly two decades.
 In the build up to the performance, Sunday at the  FORMULA 1 QATAR AIRWAYS QATAR GRAND PRIX 2026 will feature the FIA Formula 2 Feature Race and the Formula 1 Drivers’ Parade, followed by the Grand Prix, the highlight of the weekend.
 Fans attending the FORMULA 1 QATAR AIRWAYS QATAR GRAND PRIX 2026 from November 27 to 29 can catch Jason Derulo live with a three day General Admission ticket at Lusail Hill priced at QAR 600. Three day Grandstand tickets are also available in the Main Grandstand (QAR 2,000), the North Grandstand (QAR 1,500) and the Turn 2 and Turn 16 Grandstands (QAR 1,000). University students can enjoy 20% off (from QAR 480) and senior citizens aged 60 and above can enjoy 25% off (from QAR 750), with valid ID. Access to Jason Derulo’s performance is included with all 3-days ticket types.
 With Novikov at Premiere Hospitality and Lusail Hill Lounge now sold out, the F1 Experiences Champions Club remains available, offering access to the concert . Tickets are selling fast for Qatar's biggest motorsport and entertainment event. Fans can secure their place by visiting tickets.lcsc.qa.
